note: Token prices in USD per million tokens, standard (non-batch, non-cached) API rates. Each entry records where the number came from and when a human last read that page. Repro Doctor never guesses a price: a model with no entry here and no environment override reports its cost as unknown, and a live scored evaluation refuses to run rather than produce unpriced numbers. Override per run with REPRO_DOCTOR_PRICE_INPUT_PER_MTOK and REPRO_DOCTOR_PRICE_OUTPUT_PER_MTOK for the model named in REPRO_DOCTOR_MODEL. Recheck these before quoting a cost in a submission.
